physical: Watch the recruiting body's site and set a reminder — application windows are usually short.
Check age limit, education proof and physical standards (height, chest, PET distance) before you apply.
Start running, push-ups and endurance work months in advance — this is where most candidates lose marks.
Cover general knowledge, basic reasoning and elementary maths alongside your fitness routine.
Pass the physical test, get a medical clearance and carry originals + photocopies of every certificate.
clerical: Follow the department's recruitment page and note the exact application dates.
Check the required qualification, age limit and any typing/computer-skill requirement.
Practice typing and basic computer operations if the post needs a skill test.
Focus on English, reasoning, numerical ability and general awareness.
Clear the skill test and verification
Sit the typing/skill test, then complete document verification and joining formalities.
exam: Most of these exams run in tiers (Tier 1/Prelims, Tier 2/Mains) on a yearly cycle — mark every date.
Fill the form accurately; a small error in category or post preference can cost you later.
Tier 1: quant, reasoning, English, general awareness. Tier 2/Mains: deeper, sometimes descriptive or post-specific.
Take timed mock papers weekly, then spend real time reviewing every wrong answer, not just the score.
Clear skill test/interview and merit list
Complete any typing/skill test or interview, then track your result through document verification.
trade: PSUs, railways and defence services post openings for specific ITI trades — follow them closely.
Make sure your ITI trade and marks match what the specific employer is asking for.
Revise trade theory and basic aptitude
Refresh your NCVT/SCVT trade syllabus and practice simple reasoning and arithmetic.
Selection is usually a written test plus a trade/skill test — some add a short interview.
Verify certificates, complete medical checks (for uniformed trades) and begin training or duty.
technical: Follow SSC JE, RRB JE, state PWD/electricity boards and PSU career pages for openings in your branch.
Check that your diploma/degree branch, marks and age match the specific post's requirements.
Revise general engineering, reasoning, general awareness and your core technical subjects.
For posts with a second stage, practice long-answer and numerical problems in your branch.
Attend the interview (where applicable) and complete document/medical verification before joining.
elite: These are long-cycle exams — read the full syllabus and previous notifications before you start.
NCERT-level basics plus standard reference books and a daily current-affairs habit, sustained for months.
Drill MCQs and full-length mock tests for the prelim/GATE stage, with strict timing and negative-marking awareness.
Practice answer-writing or core-subject problem solving, with regular feedback and revision.
Work on communication, current affairs and, for defence/PSU entries, technical and personality rounds.

physical: Objective paper on general knowledge, reasoning and basic maths.
Physical Efficiency Test (PET) / Physical Standard Test (PST)
Running, height/chest and other physical standards for the post.
Fitness check plus verification of age, education and category certificates.
clerical: Objective paper on English, reasoning, numerical ability and general awareness.
Typing speed or computer proficiency test for clerical posts.
Certificates and eligibility proofs are checked before appointment.
exam: Objective screening exam on quant, reasoning, English and general awareness.
Deeper paper, sometimes descriptive or post-specific.
Typing/skill test or interview followed by document verification.
trade: Objective paper testing trade theory and basic aptitude.
Practical test in your ITI trade.
ITI certificate, marksheet and category proof are checked.
technical: General engineering plus core-branch objective paper.
Personal interview (for some posts) followed by certificate verification.
elite: Objective screening exam or your GATE score, depending on the exam.
In-depth written papers or specialisation-based evaluation.
Final interview or SSB-style assessment before the merit list.

jobs.name: SSC MTS / Havaldar
jobs.overview: Multi Tasking Staff (non-technical office support) and Havaldar (CBIC/CBN) roles across central government offices — one of the most accessible entry points right after Class 10.
jobs.edu: Passed Class 10 (Matriculation) from a recognised board

jobs.name: SSC GD Constable
jobs.overview: General Duty constable posts across BSF, CISF, CRPF, SSB, ITBP, Assam Rifles and the Secretariat Security Force, recruited through one common SSC exam.
jobs.edu: Passed Class 10 (Matriculation) from a recognised board

jobs.name: Railway Group D
jobs.overview: Track maintainer, helper and similar posts across Indian Railways — large-scale recruitment that regularly opens lakhs of vacancies nationwide.
jobs.edu: Passed Class 10 or ITI from a recognised institute

jobs.name: India Post GDS
jobs.overview: Gramin Dak Sevak roles (Branch Postmaster, Assistant Branch Postmaster, Dak Sevak) that run rural post offices — selection is merit-based with no written exam.
jobs.edu: Passed Class 10 with local language as a subject
jobs.salary: Time Related Continuity Allowance, roughly ₹10,000–₹14,500 + allowances
jobs.examLabel: GDS has no written exam — optional GK/aptitude practice

jobs.name: Police Constable (State)
jobs.overview: Entry-level constable posts in state police forces — one of the largest uniformed recruitment streams, run separately by each state.
jobs.age: 18–25 years (varies by state; relaxation for reserved categories)
jobs.edu: Passed Class 10 or 12 depending on the state's notification

jobs.name: Forest Guard
jobs.overview: Field-level protection and patrolling duties in forest divisions — combines fieldwork with basic record-keeping.
jobs.edu: Passed Class 10 or 12 depending on the state's notification

jobs.name: BSF / CISF / CRPF Constable (Tradesman)
jobs.overview: Tradesman posts (cook, washerman, barber, tailor and similar trades) supporting central paramilitary units.

jobs.name: SSB (Constable)
jobs.overview: General Duty constable posts in the Sashastra Seema Bal, guarding India's Nepal and Bhutan borders.
jobs.edu: Passed Class 10 (Matriculation) from a recognised board

jobs.name: Indian Army Agniveer (GD)
jobs.overview: General Duty soldier under the Agnipath scheme — a four-year tenure with a defined path to permanent enrolment for top performers.

jobs.salary: Starts around ₹30,000/month package including allowances and Seva Nidhi corpus

jobs.name: Navy SSR / MR

jobs.name: State PSC (Group 1 / 2 / 3 / 4)

jobs.age: 21–40 years (varies widely by state; relaxation for reserved categories)
jobs.edu: Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognised university
jobs.salary: State pay scale, roughly ₹56,100 and above depending on the post and state

jobs.name: Bank PO / Clerk
jobs.overview: Probationary Officer and Clerk cadre posts in public sector and central banks, filled through IBPS, SBI and RBI recruitment exams.
jobs.edu: Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognised university
jobs.salary: Roughly ₹29,000–₹55,000 gross per month depending on the post, plus allowances

jobs.name: Insurance AO / LIC AAO
jobs.overview: Administrative Officer and Assistant Administrative Officer posts in public-sector insurance companies like LIC, NIACL and GIC.
jobs.edu: Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognised university
jobs.salary: Roughly ₹45,000–₹55,000 gross per month, plus allowances

jobs.name: Railway Group B (Various)
jobs.overview: Graduate-level supervisory and gazetted-track posts across Indian Railways, filled through RRB's Group B notifications and promotions.
jobs.age: 18–36 years (varies by post; relaxation for reserved categories)
jobs.edu: Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognised university

jobs.name: NABARD Grade A / B
jobs.overview: Officer-grade posts in India's apex rural development bank, covering agriculture finance, rural development and banking supervision.
jobs.age: 21–32 years (varies by grade; relaxation for reserved categories)
jobs.edu: Bachelor's degree in any discipline (specific disciplines required for some specialist posts)
jobs.salary: Roughly ₹58,000–₹85,000 gross per month, plus allowances

jobs.name: CDS / AFCAT (For Graduates)
jobs.overview: Combined Defence Services and Air Force Common Admission Test — officer-entry routes into the Army, Navy and Air Force for graduates.
jobs.edu: Bachelor's degree in any discipline (engineering degree required for some technical entries)
jobs.salary: Officer pay scale with rank allowances after commissioning
jobs.examLabel: UPSC CDS General Knowledge Paper Pattern

jobs.name: Teaching (TET / CTET / KVS / NVS / DSSSB)
jobs.overview: Teaching posts in central and state schools, requiring a bachelor's degree plus a B.Ed and a qualifying TET/CTET score.
jobs.age: 21–35 years (varies by state/board; relaxation for reserved categories)
jobs.edu: Bachelor's degree plus B.Ed, with a qualifying TET/CTET score

jobs.name: Police SI / Inspector (State)
jobs.overview: Sub-Inspector and Inspector-level posts in state police forces, combining supervisory duties with active field responsibility.
jobs.edu: Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognised university

jobs.name: Others (State / Central Jobs)
jobs.overview: A wide catch-all of additional graduate-level Group A and B posts advertised directly by ministries, PSUs and regulatory bodies.
jobs.edu: Bachelor's degree in any discipline (minimum, varies by post)
jobs.salary: Varies by pay level and department

jobs.name: GATE → PSU Jobs (ONGC, BHEL, IOCL, NTPC, BEL, HAL, etc.)
jobs.overview: A strong GATE score lets PSUs shortlist engineering graduates directly for Management/Engineer Trainee roles, skipping a separate PSU-specific written exam.
jobs.age: Up to 26–30 years depending on the PSU (relaxation for reserved categories)
jobs.edu: B.Tech / B.E. in the relevant engineering discipline

jobs.name: PSUs via Direct Recruitment (TATA Power, SAIL, BPCL, etc.)
jobs.overview: Some PSUs run their own campus placement or direct-recruitment drives for engineering graduates, separate from the GATE route.
jobs.age: Up to 27–30 years depending on the PSU
jobs.edu: B.Tech / B.E. in the relevant engineering discipline
jobs.salary: PSU management trainee scale, roughly ₹50,000–₹1,50,000 (CTC) + allowances
jobs.examLabel: PSU Direct Recruitment Written Test Pattern (typical)

jobs.name: SSC JE (Through GATE)
jobs.overview: Some SSC Junior Engineer posts also accept a valid GATE score as an alternative screening route for B.Tech graduates.
jobs.edu: B.Tech / B.E. in the relevant engineering discipline

jobs.name: DRDO Scientist 'B'
jobs.overview: Entry-level scientist posts at DRDO's defence research labs, working on projects across missiles, electronics, materials and more.
jobs.age: Up to 28 years (relaxation for reserved categories)
jobs.edu: B.Tech / B.E. (or equivalent) with a strong academic record; GATE score often used for shortlisting

jobs.name: ISRO Scientist / Engineer 'SC'
jobs.overview: Entry-level scientist/engineer posts at ISRO, working on India's space research, satellite and launch vehicle programmes.
jobs.age: Up to 35 years (relaxation for reserved categories)
jobs.edu: B.Tech / B.E. in the relevant engineering discipline with a strong academic record

jobs.name: BARC / NPCIL Engineer
jobs.overview: Scientific Officer and engineer posts in India's atomic energy establishments, working on nuclear power and research programmes.
jobs.age: Up to 26 years (relaxation for reserved categories)
jobs.edu: B.Tech / B.E. in the relevant engineering discipline (through BARC Training School or direct recruitment)

jobs.name: Indian Army (TES Entry)
jobs.overview: Technical Entry Scheme lets Class 12 PCM students join as officer cadets and complete their engineering degree during training — B.Tech holders can also apply through direct technical entries.
jobs.age: 16.5–19.5 years for TES after Class 12 (separate norms apply for direct B.Tech entries)
jobs.edu: Class 12 with PCM for TES; B.Tech/B.E. for direct technical graduate entries
jobs.salary: Officer pay scale with rank allowances after commissioning

jobs.name: Indian Navy (SSC Technical)
jobs.overview: Short Service Commission technical entry for engineering graduates into the Indian Navy's Executive, Engineering or Electrical branches.
jobs.edu: B.Tech / B.E. in the relevant engineering discipline
jobs.salary: Officer pay scale with rank allowances after commissioning
jobs.examLabel: Navy SSC Technical Written Test Pattern (typical)

jobs.name: Air Force (SSC Tech)
jobs.overview: Short Service Commission technical entry for engineering graduates into the Indian Air Force's Aeronautical and other technical branches.
jobs.edu: B.Tech / B.E. in the relevant engineering discipline
jobs.salary: Officer pay scale with rank allowances after commissioning
jobs.examLabel: Air Force SSC Tech Written Test Pattern (typical)

jobs.name: UPSC Engineering Services (IES / ESE)
jobs.overview: One of India's top engineering exams, recruiting Class I/II engineering officers into central departments like Railways, Roads, Telecom and Power.
jobs.edu: B.Tech / B.E. in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical or Electronics & Telecom engineering

jobs.name: State Engineering Services
jobs.overview: State-level equivalent of the UPSC Engineering Services exam, recruiting Assistant Engineers into state technical departments.
jobs.age: 21–35 years (varies by state; relaxation for reserved categories)
jobs.edu: B.Tech / B.E. in the relevant engineering discipline

jobs.name: Others (PSUs / Research Organizations)
jobs.overview: A wide catch-all of additional B.Tech-level posts advertised directly by PSUs, research organisations and technical departments.
jobs.edu: B.Tech / B.E. in the relevant engineering discipline (minimum, varies by post)
jobs.salary: Varies by pay level and organisation
